lines.t: Rejoice in the wisdom of the Lord
And find joy in His correction
For only those who have received
Of the Spirit of truth are able to see
And only those who love the truth
Rejoice in the wisdom of the Lord
Yet only those who embrace the Messiah fully
Who also write His words upon their hearts
And peace the kind of which only the Lord can give
Rejoice in the wisdom of the Lord
And find joy in His correction
